description: Locast desktop client capabilities for the main window. Least privilege: only the plugin commands the client's own code invokes are granted. listen/unlisten back @tauri-apps/api/event (Rust to JS events) and dialog open backs the media import file picker. App commands are typed IPC and are not ACL-gated; media is served by the locast:// custom protocol, which needs no permission. No window, path, app, fs, notification, opener, os, process or log command is reachable from the webview, and the dialog plugin's alert/confirm overrides (message, confirm) are deliberately not granted. tests/capabilities.rs pins this list.
